full_prompt_en: A square minimalist image presents a tiny seated person against an immense clear blue field and a near-white horizontal ground. The upper three quarters are mostly uninterrupted sky, deepening gently from a pale turquoise near the horizon to a quieter medium blue at the top. At the far left, a tall white curved wall enters from outside the frame and descends to the horizon line, its rounded outer edge making the only large vertical shape. The lower band is an almost empty sunlit floor, clean and level, meeting the sky at a thin distant line. Just left of center near this line, a solitary person sits sideways on a low pale ledge. The figure wears a dark top and ochre-yellow trousers; the head is slightly bowed, and the small feet point toward the foreground. A soft shadow lies beside the ledge, while a much larger blue-gray shadow from the wall spreads diagonally across the lower left and fades toward the bright floor. The person occupies only a few marks in the scale of the square, so the open space is felt before any narrative detail. The view is at a low, distant eye level, leaving the figure and horizon close to the bottom edge. Sunlight from high on the right keeps the floor bright and makes the wall's shadow broad but soft-edged. Surface detail is almost absent: faint tonal shifts in blue, smooth white planes, and the few dark and yellow marks of the sitter carry the visual weight. The composition is deliberately off-center and extremely quiet, balancing a massive curved edge with a small human presence and an expansive, unbroken blue atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形极简图像让一位小小的静坐人物处在无边清澈的蓝色场域和近白色水平地面之间。上方约四分之三几乎全是不中断的天空，从地平线附近的浅绿松石蓝轻轻加深到顶部安静的中蓝色。最左边，一面高大的白色曲墙从画外进入并落到地平线，其圆润外缘是唯一巨大的竖向形状。下方是一条几乎空无一物的受光地面，干净而平整，以纤细的远方界线接到天空。在这条界线附近、中央略偏左，一人侧身坐在低矮的浅色台沿上。人物穿深色上衣和赭黄色长裤，头微微低下，小小的双脚朝向前景。台沿旁有柔和阴影，而墙投下更大一片蓝灰色影子，斜斜铺过左下方，向明亮地面渐淡。人物在方形画面里只占寥寥几笔，所以观者先感到开放空间，才注意叙事细节。视点较低而遥远，让人物与地平线都靠近底边。来自右上高处的阳光保持地面明亮，并使墙影宽阔而边缘略柔。表面细节几乎全无：蓝色里的微弱色调变化、平滑白色平面以及坐者身上的少量深色与黄色痕迹，承担了视觉重量。构图有意偏心且极其安静，以庞大的弧形边缘、小小的人物存在和广阔不间断的蓝色空气互相平衡。
style_prompt_en: A minimalist digital image reduces the frame to a few smooth color fields, one large curved boundary, and a tiny focal accent. Expansive medium blue grades gently toward a lighter horizon; near-white occupies a narrow lower strip and a larger side plane. Edges are clean but not harsh, with a broad blue-gray diagonal shadow supplying the main sense of depth. Direct high light creates luminous white areas without surface grain or gloss, while the shadow remains soft enough to preserve the quiet atmosphere. Extreme scale difference and off-center placement give the small dark and ochre marks unusual weight. Most of the square stays open, allowing color, proportion, and the relation between positive shape and negative space to carry the image. The effect is spare, contemplative, and airy.
style_prompt_zh: 极简数字图像把画面缩减为少数平滑色域、一条巨大的弧形边界和一个微小焦点。宽广的中蓝色向较浅的地平线轻轻渐变；近白色占据狭窄下带与更大的侧面平面。边缘清楚但不生硬，一片宽阔蓝灰色斜影提供主要纵深。高处直射光造出明亮白色区域，没有颗粒或光泽，而阴影仍足够柔和，保留宁静气氛。极端的尺度差异和偏心位置让小块深色与赭黄色痕迹获得特别的重量。方形画面的绝大部分保持开放，使色彩、比例和正形与留白的关系承担视觉表达。效果简省、沉思而通透。
theme_en: A small seated figure at the edge of a vast blue and white space
theme_zh: 广阔蓝白空间边缘的一位静坐小人物
name: Minimalism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
